```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

read_if <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) else tibble()
}

# Reconciled headline figures (dsc-stats-integration; claim-register.md #9, #10, #13)
# TODO(reach-v4): the reach line reads people_reached_confirmed_ucla.
# When Tim lifts the provisional flag on person-level reach v4 (dsc-stats-integration
# PROVENANCE.md, "Person-level reach: definition"), replace that one row in
# headline_aggregates.csv, update claim-register.md #13, and change reach_note below.
headline <- read_if("data/processed/canonical/headline_aggregates.csv")
hl <- function(key) {
  x <- headline |> filter(metric_id == key) |> pull(display)
  if (length(x) == 0) "—" else x[[1]]
}
reach_note <- "confirmed UCLA researchers used DSC instruction or consultation, 2017 to September 2026. This is a floor: people are counted only when their identity could be confirmed."
```

The Data Science Center (DSC) supports UCLA researchers with data consultation, instruction, and the infrastructure that keeps research data usable. This site is the evidence layer: each figure below states its unit and window and links to the page where it is built.

::: {.history-band}
**Since 1961.** UCLA has kept research data for reuse since 1961, when political scientist Dwaine Marvick founded the Political Behavior Archive. The unit's name and institutional home have changed several times since; what persisted is the stewardship of research data and the work of widening access to it. [Read the history](https://ucla-data-science-center.github.io/ssda-dsc-history/history.html)
:::

::: {.brand-wave aria-hidden="true"}
:::

## What the evidence establishes

DSC's work shows up in research outputs, not only in service counts. Two documented engagements illustrate this: for one helicopter-surveillance processing task, an approximately 159-fold runtime reduction was observed under the reported conditions; and DSC contributed data integration, analysis, and visualization support to research later recognized through UCLA's 2024 Public Impact Research Awards. These are illustrative cases, not a representative sample. [See the cases and their limits](consulting.qmd#research-impact).

## Three ways DSC contributes

::: {.grid .pathways}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
[]{.brand-el .brand-node1 aria-hidden="true"}

### Research enabled

Researchers across campus bring data problems to DSC for consultation, and some engagements become multi-year collaborations.

[`r hl("consultations_recorded_series")`]{.pathway-figure}
[recorded consultations, 2017 to September 2026. A floor: recording practices and service capacity changed from mid-2024, so later counts cannot establish whether demand fell.]{.pathway-unit}

[Consultation evidence](consulting.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
[]{.brand-el .brand-linechart1 aria-hidden="true"}

### Research capability built

DSC moved from teaching its own campus to co-running instruction across the University of California, and campus volunteers it trained went on to lead much of the teaching.

[`r hl("instruction_sessions_lifetime")`]{.pathway-figure}
[workshop sessions, May 2017 to May 2026. Registered seats by program are charted on the pathway page.]{.pathway-unit}

[Capability pathway](capability.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
[]{.brand-el .brand-circular aria-hidden="true"}

### Shared infrastructure sustained

DSC runs UCLA Dataverse and governed access to restricted data, the current form of the stewardship that began in 1961.

[Figure pending]{.pathway-figure .pending}
[The Dataverse dataset count will appear once two sources are reconciled and the count is dated and registered.]{.pathway-unit}

[Infrastructure evidence](infrastructure.qmd)
:::
